office_does: The county clerk keeps Superior Court records, takes court filings, fees and restitution, and runs the court's administrative operations.
race_blurb: Two first-time candidates seek to replace retiring Republican Clerk Tim Fitzgerald: Republican Dave Lucas, Cheney's municipal court administrator, and Democrat Elliot Robison, a health-care data analyst. The race contrasts court-administration experience with outside technology skills.

candidates.summary: Cheney Municipal Court administrator and retired Marine Corps lieutenant colonel running on court-administration experience.
highlights: Cites e-filing reforms, a court food bank and a Narcan center he started in Cheney [S5]
Promises faster, more accurate service and modernization that protects sensitive information [S1]

experience.basis: Runs on 'Experience Matters' and his record as a municipal court administrator, though he has not held countywide office.

candidates.summary: CHAS Health business intelligence analyst and first-time candidate proposing translated forms, court notifications and public operational reporting.
highlights: Proposes expanded court guides, notifications, translated forms and public operational reporting [S1]
Pledges a constructive, union-friendly workplace; endorsed by the Spokane Regional Labor Council and Spokane County Democrats [S1][S2]

experience.basis: Calls for 'a new generation of leadership' and pitches newer, fresher skills from outside court administration.
